book.name: Hibru
book.title: Hibru Te launiu e taataa i na Hibru

content: I mua roo tammaki na vahao ia ma na ara TeAtua ni tattara ake na profet raa ki tattara ake na tipuna taatou raa,

e meia i roto na aho nei, TeAtua ku tattara mai taatou i na mahi te Tamariki Aia raa; te Tama Aia ni hirihiri ki ttino na mee hakatoa i te hakaotioti, ia te Tama hoki TeAtua ni pena iho na mee hakatoa i roto te maarama nei.

Tama raa e hakamahina mai na mahi hai mmahi TeAtua, tena Aia Hokoia e tipu roo pera ma TeAtua, tena Aia e pena te maarama nei hakaatoa ma na mahi na tattara Aia. Aia e ssoro na hai sara te maarama nei raa no oti, tena Aia ku noho i te vahi laaua TeAtua te Tama na Mahi Hai mmahi raa.
Te Tamariki TeAtua raa e hakanaaniu i aruna na ensel, e ssau pera ma te inoa TeAtua e kou ake Aia raa e hakanaaniu i aruna na inoa na ensel raa hoki.
Maitaname TeAtua se hai vahao ni meake he ensel ma,

content.text: “Akoe he Tamariki Anau;
te aho nei Anau ku mee mo Tamana akoe.”

content: Ia TeAtua hoki ni se hai tattara e tattara ake he ensel ma,

content.text: “Anau ku mee mo Tamana tama raa, tena tama raa ku mee mo tama Anau.”

content: Emeia te saaita TeAtua ku mee ki kauna ria iho te Tamariki Aia raa ki hamai i te maarama nei, Aia e meake ma:

content.text: “Kootou na ensel Anau raa hakaatoa ki lotu ake Tama raa.”

content: Emeia i te vahi na ensel raa, TeAtua e tattara ake ma,

content.text: “Anau e mee na ensel Anau raa ki ssau pera ma ni matani,
tena ki mee na tama hehekau Anau raa ki ssau pera ma ni ahi.”

content: Ia i te vahi te Tamariki Aia raa, TeAtua e tattara ma,

content.text: “Te Hakamaatua ana Akoe raa e me ki moe tahi se isi te hakaoti!
Na mahi Akoe raa e kou mai te tauareka i na tama hakaatoa.
Akoe e hihai koi na tiputipu e ttonu,
tena ki se hihai na mee e ssara.
Tera hea Anau, TeAtua Akoe raa ni hirihiri Akoe,
tena ki kou atu Akoe te hihia e rahi e raka ma te hihia na soa Akoe raa hakaatoa.”
“TeAriki, Akoe e pena iho te maarama nei i te kaamata roo,
tena ki pena te vaelani raa ma na rima roo Akoe.
Na mee roo hakaatoa e me ki seai,
e meia Akoe e me ki noho tahi roo,
na mee raa e me ki oo no se mmau pera ma ni paamaro.
Akoe e me ki hatuhatu na mee raa pera ma ni kaukahu,
ia na mee raa e me ki ssau pera ma na hekau.
Emeia Akoe e me ki tipu koi peenaa na vahao hakaatoa, tena te ora Akoe raa se lavaa te isi te hakaoti.”

content: TeAtua se hai vahao ni meake he ensel ma:

content.text: “Noho i te vahi laaua Anau nei ki tae roo te saaita Anau e tuku na tama e kiri lloto akoe raa i raro na tapuvae akoe raa pera ma he tuai.”

content: Kaa na ensel raa niaa? Na ensel raa ni anana tera e hehekau ma TeAtua. Tena TeAtua e kauna na tama raa ki oo no tokonaki na tama e me ki too te ora e ora tahi raa.
